header:
Date: 2026-08-04
Start: 16:00 UTC
Duration: 1h 12m
Location: Zoom (company all-hands)
Attendees: Ava Martinez (CEO), Marcus Lee (CTO), Priya Nair (VP Eng), Jamal Osei (Head of Product), Lena Chen (Head of People), Diego Ramos (VP Sales), Nora Patel (Head of Security), Samir Gupta (Director, Observability) and ~140 others
Recording: yes (auto)
Notes: leadership update + open Q&A
summary: Company all-hands focused on Q3 operational priorities, transparency on hiring and budget, product performance investments (latency/cost tradeoffs), and security/compliance updates. Leadership introduced a new "Lighthouse" initiative to centralize strategic bets and clarified canary rollout rules. Open Q&A covered SOC2 timeline, Dedicated vs Hosted guidance for large customers, and planned changes to on-call rotation and observability dashboards.
topics:
1) Lighthouse initiative + definition of success
2) Q3 priority areas: performance, reliability, go-to-market enablement, hiring cadence
3) Budget & hiring: tradeoffs and runway considerations
4) Security & compliance: SOC2, KMS, audit logs
5) Observability improvements and developer ergonomics
6) Open Q&A
transcript:
[00:00] Ava: okay hi everyone, welcome to the all hands, thanks for joining. I'm Ava. Uh today we want to be a little bit shorter than usual, 70-ish minutes, got a tight agenda.
[00:16] Marcus: hey folks, Marcus here, quick heads up — we'll go through tech highlights first then product then q&a.
[00:30] Priya: hi, team — quick update from eng: we've been dogfooding the continuous batching improvements, seeing about 12 to 18% token cost reduction on average for web traffic but — uh — not uniformly across long-form bursts. so there is more tuning to do.
[00:55] Jamal: quick context, the "Lighthouse" idea is basically to pick three strategic bets for Q3 where we concentrate product, infra, and GTM so we don't spread thin. the bets are: 1) extreme latency SLOs for interactive apps, 2) Dedicated capacity for mid-market enterprise, 3) verticalized solutions for search & customer support.
[01:18] Ava: i want to emphasize transparency — we'll publish a dashboard that shows progress on each lighthouse bet weekly. not the whole payroll but high level metrics.
[01:34] Lena: also want to call out changes to how we prioritize hiring requests — there will be a short rubric, it's about impact on lighthouse bets and critical operational risk.
[01:50] Diego: from sales, customers keep asking about dedicated vs hosted overhead and what signals should push a POC into a Reserved capacity conversation. we'll share a decision tree.
[02:08] Nora: security quick — SOC2 phase 2 kickoff is next month, KMS integration for private deployments is in design, and we will publish an FAQ for Sales and SEs.
[02:27] Samir: observability — rolling out token-level tracing in staging this week, which should make it easier to correlate latency spikes to model/version.
[02:40] Audience (mic): applause / cheers (brief)
[03:00] Ava: ok now demo highlight — Marcus, you want to show the latency profile?
[03:08] Marcus: sure; so we ran a 1,024 token tail experiment across our 80/20 load split and found that the new kernel selection reduces p95 by around 30ms for small seqs but adds about 10ms for some quantized paths. there's a trade — cost decreases, sometimes latency edges up.
[03:38] Priya: yeah there's a tradeoff matrix in the doc. the key is we can make profile-based routing pick the lower-latency path at the cost of some throughput.
[03:50] Audience question: any updates on private/on-prem customers and air-gapped installs?
[03:57] Nora: yes, we have two pilot customers for private on-prem and both have unique networking needs. the package will include a local control-plane option and KMS hooks. still early.
[04:18] Jamal: product rollout policy update — canaries will default to 10% for major model switches, with automatic fallback to previous variant on error spikes. we'll add a warmup period for KV cache priming to reduce cold-start regressions.
[04:45] Diego: on pricing, we will not change public hosted pricing this quarter but for Dedicated we are looking at more granular bundles to match mid-market patterns.
[05:00] Audience comment (murmur): "how will this affect current pilots?"
[05:05] Ava: good question — pilots shouldn't be negatively impacted; SEs will get recommended settings per pilot.
[05:12] [05:12] Marcus: quick note about kernels — some model families still show instability with the quantized path on A100 gen2 earlier this week; we rolled a patch but need a follow-up.
[05:30] [06:00] Priya: ops update — we will adjust on-call rotations to reduce pager fatigue, moving to 48 hour handoffs for infra owners and adding an extra backup on high-traffic days. feedback pls to people ops.
[06:22] [06:40] Lena: yes please fill the anonymous pulse if you are affected, we'll revise.
[07:00] Audience question: "what's runway and hiring status?"
[07:08] Ava: runway is healthy but we have to be deliberate; hiring will be prioritized for lighthouse bets and critical ops. teams must submit requests with clear impact statements.
[07:28] Diego: tying to GTM — we'll focus inbound motion for self-serve but allocate SEs for mid-market Dedicated POCs.
[07:44] [08:00] Nora: security Q — some folks asked about encryption at rest for hosted API. we already encrypt at rest and in transit; the KMS integration gives additional customer-managed key options for Dedicated/Private.
[08:20] Audience: "timeline for SOC2?"
[08:25] Nora: target is to complete Type II readiness audit by Q1 next year; phase 1 documents will be out mid-August.
[08:40] [09:00] Jamal: product clarifying — "verticalized solutions" means we will publish starter packs for search and support use-cases: prompts, evals, and quantization settings tuned per workload.
[09:20] Priya: engineering will deliver quantization recommendations and a lighter 8-bit runtime for small VMs by mid-Q3.
[09:36] Audience: "how do we measure success for lighthouse?"
[09:40] Ava: success metrics: latency p95 improvement, gross margin impact from cost reduction, number of customers on Dedicated, and number of closed-loop regressions detected by our evals.
[09:58] [10:15] Samir: observability will expose a weekly lighthouse dashboard: traffic share, p95 latency, cost per 1k tokens, rollback events.
[10:30] Audience follow-up: "can we see the dashboard before public release?"
[10:35] Ava: yes leaders will get access and we'll ask for feedback.
[10:45] [11:00] Diego: sales playbook update — we'll publish a one-pager for AEs on when to recommend Dedicated and a checklist for procurement items.
[11:16] Audience question: "Any change to compensation or headcount?"
[11:22] Lena: compensation stable; headcount prioritized; we will not hire across the board.
[11:35] [12:00] Open Q&A (rapidfire):
[12:05] Employee 1: will we extend free credits for startups?
[12:08] Diego: probably yes, but with tighter qualifying signals.
[12:12] Employee 2: will the new batching change affect latency-sensitive customers?
[12:15] Marcus: we'll allow per-route overrides so sensitive customers can opt out of aggressive batching.
[12:28] Employee 3: can we have more clarity on regional capacity?
[12:32] Ava: we're expanding EU and APAC regions; details in the infra update next week.
[12:44] Employee 4 (mumble): requests for more async docs and runbooks.
[12:48] Priya: noted. docs team — we'll add sprint to backlog.
[13:05] [13:30] Final recap by Ava: recap: lighthouse bets, hiring rubric, SOC2 timeline, observability dashboard, canary policy. next steps: leadership doc next week, team leads submit resource asks, security FAQ. thanks all, meeting adjourned.
[13:50] (end)
notes: Transcript contains minor transcription artifacts: model names and kernel terms sometimes transcribed incorrectly; timestamps approximate. Action items captured in metadata above. Deck and detailed lighthouse doc linked in the follow-up email (internal doc link).
